text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On this tight-turning track, Twin Turbo 
executes a "breathing run" where she 
decelerates once before accelerating 
again. And—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through extra training, she mastered that 
running style. To replicate it on a 
grander racecourse this time, she heads 
for the GII St. Lite Kinen.
